answer: Borrow the patience of a reef: let standing grow only with survived time, never bought. A new identity declares one live endpoint and starts at one-sixteenth weight, one marble in the jar. Each epoch, verifiers fire random pings; a reply must land within 200 milliseconds from an endpoint no other identity uses, and three misses suspend the account. Four tides of survived checks double weight to full strength. Fielding 1,000 fakes means renting 1,000 servers at $3 each — $3,000 — and a full day of waiting, so the attack costs more than the pool.
